verdict.overall: The biggest move since Sunday is TSLA's 7.4% jump, yet options sellers are still leaning against further upside (resistance across all four expiries), while PLTR, NVDA and ZETA saw some resistance levels soften to neutral even as their prices fell, suggesting slightly rising confidence in range trades there. AMAT, AVGO and MU look calmest and most range-bound, but PLTR, ZETA, AMD, AMAT, NVDA and APP all carry earnings inside the next four weeks plus pricey options, making TSLA and APP the least settled names right now.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: weaker - price jumped 7.4% to $399.81 but options sellers still resist it (opposing for all four weeks). The 11-06 magnet level rose to $390 with floor $360/ceiling $425, and 11-13 flipped into resistance too, ceiling widening to $450. Options are pricey; earnings not until 2027.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: little changed to slightly stronger - price fell 6.4% to $184.11 but two expiries (11-13, 11-20) flipped from resistance to neutral. Floor sits near $180, ceiling $202.5-$210. Earnings land tomorrow (2026-11-02) and options are pricey to very pricey, so a sharp move is likely.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: little changed - price eased 3.0% to $204.64, magnets drifted down with it (around $215-220), and 11-20 flipped from resistance to neutral. Floor sits $190-200, ceiling $225-230. Earnings due 2026-11-17 fall inside this window, adding uncertainty on top of the downtrend.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: price fell sharply (-8.3% to $31.17) but options turned less resistant - 11-13 and 11-20 flipped from opposing to neutral. Floor now $30, ceiling tight near $32-35. Earnings hit 2026-11-09, and options are very pricey throughout, so swings could be sharp.
tickers.AMAT: Since Sunday: little changed - price rose 3.4% to $390.09, magnets drifted down toward price ($420-450 across expiries) while floors held near $350-370 and ceilings near $420-440. All four weeks stay neutral. Earnings on 2026-11-12 fall inside this window, adding event risk.
tickers.AMD: Since Sunday: little changed - price slipped 2.3% to $504.80, magnets eased slightly ($555-560) while floors and ceilings mostly held. The 11-20 week keeps resisting the downside (magnet $480). Earnings land 2026-11-03, just days away, which could move the stock before the 11-06 expiry even starts.
tickers.MU: Since Sunday: little changed - price edged up 0.8% to $884.74, with magnets easing slightly toward $950 and floors/ceilings broadly stable ($800-1000). All weeks stay neutral. No earnings until December, so this window is free of that risk, though the downtrend continues.
tickers.AVGO: Since Sunday: little changed - price rose 1.4% to $326.08, magnets and ceilings shifted only slightly ($340-350 range) with floors near $300-320. All four weeks remain neutral. No earnings until December, keeping this one calmer than most despite the broader downtrend.
tickers.APP: No Sunday baseline. Price sits at $228.50 in a steep downtrend with RSI near oversold levels. All four weeks are neutral but magnet levels sit well above price ($280-300), with floor near $200-220. Earnings land 2026-11-04, and options are very pricey, so a big move is expected.
tickers.SPY: Since Sunday: little changed - price dipped 0.6% to $755.72. Near-term (11-06) magnet level is $769 (£109.38), floor $750 (£106.68), ceiling $788 (£112.09), slightly tighter than before. No earnings. Options stay pricey across all four weeks, fairly typical for this index tracker.
tickers.QQQ: Since Sunday: little changed - price fell 2.0% to $690.49. Near-term (11-06) magnet level is $720 (£80.37, rough since ISUS only partly tracks the Nasdaq), floor $675 (£77.30), ceiling $769 (£83.72). The 11-13 ceiling compressed sharply. No earnings; options fair to pricey.
